label: Fees & Payments
seo_description: Multi-currency fees, invoices, receipts, discounts, arrears, and finance-ready reporting.
headline: Every invoice, receipt, and balance in one finance workspace.
subheadline: Configure fee structures tied to academic context, issue invoices, record payments and receipts, surface arrears, give parents clear billing visibility, and export finance views leadership can use—without reconciling shadow spreadsheets.

segments.title: Unified balances
segments.body: Guardian views and finance dashboards stay aligned to the same invoices and receipts.

segments.title: Receipt discipline
segments.body: Offline receipt capture can sync through governed queues when your deployment supports it.

segments.title: Reporting depth
segments.body: Exports and summaries structured for how schools review revenue and arrears.

problem_section.title: Billing confusion strains trust
problem_section.body: When invoices, receipts, and balances are fragmented, finance teams reconcile manually and parents call for the same answers. RunMyCampus brings fee setup, invoicing, receipts, and arrears into one auditable flow.

bullets: Structured arrears and adjustment handling with traceability
Payment history schools can defend in reviews
Operational clarity across campuses and academic years
Transparent balances and receipts in the portal
Fewer surprise bills when expectations are visible
Cross-campus posture when your deployment spans tenants
Permissioned access and audit-friendly trails where your policy requires them
